comments.text: what a mature and needed video, I’ve been a fan for a long time now and something I’ve come to understand is that at the end of the day, you reallt ARE just a regular person like anyone else, that’s why I think this message is so important, not just for this fandom, but in general, too often people lose sight of reality and place the people they admire, whether they’re artists, creators, public figures..etc..on such a high pedestal that it becomes almost inhuman, so I really appreciate you reminding us to become aware of our own behavior, blind loyalty in fandoms can be powerful but also so dangerous, it makes us overlook flaws, excuse harmful actions, and sometimes even turn against others in defense of someone we’ve never personally met, it can cloud judgement and kinda create environments where people stop thinking critically and simply follow the crowd, subconsciously, this reallt affects all of us, we’re just human after all, but the more we participate in these patterns the harder it becomes to separate genuine support from unhealthy attachment, that’s why it’s so important to step back sometimes and check ourselves, are our words and actions truly right? are they uplifting or hurting others in the process? agcountability isn’t about tearing someone down, it’s about staying grounded in truth, even while showing love and respect, it comes from a place of love, so thank you for this video, I genuinely hope that as a community, we take your words to heart, reflect on them, and grow from them with self awareness, humility, and with God by our side, and like that, I believe things can become healthier and better again 💗
